contract: ../CONTRACT.md — geographic Lens and local Fieldbook with honest source metadata, safe saving and preserved legacy tools.

accessibility.evidence: Lens tab Arrow/Home/End navigation and escaped labels pass rendered component tests. Existing workspace keyboard/focus workflow is retained. New actions use labeled 44px controls; this is scoped acceptance, not full WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: Actual desktop, 390px phone and 667x375 landscape were rendered. Library remains visible and scrollable with no document horizontal overflow; source attribution remains visible above the mobile sheet.

loading.evidence: Rendered Fieldbook and Lens tests cover loading/busy presentation; browser waits for initialized owners before interaction.

empty.evidence: Rendered component tests cover empty Lens and Library with labeled inspect/create actions and no account requirement.

error.evidence: Rendered component tests cover failure messages with retained note editing and export. Controller/native IndexedDB tests exercise quota, conflict, malformed imports and recovery. These are fixtures, not live storage failures.

partial.evidence: External services blocked for browser acceptance. Source observation time, resolution and uncertainty remain explicitly Unknown.

success.evidence: checks.json records real coordinate search, save note/place, reload, JSON backup, copy restore and responsive checks.

permission.reason: No new account permissions; local file chooser and explicit import/export actions only. Paid capabilities remain blocked.
